title: The Myth of Perfectionism
hook: "You're more productive when you're perfect, right?"
script:
(Opening shot with a person working at their desk)
Narrator (in a calm tone): "We've been told that being perfect is key to success. We strive for perfection in our work, and in return, we'll be rewarded."

(Cut to an animation of a scale tipping towards perfectionism)
Narrator: "But what if I told you that this mindset is actually holding you back?"

(Cut to a person struggling with stress and anxiety)
Narrator: "Perfectionism can lead to overwork, burnout, and decreased motivation."

(Cut to a person embracing imperfection and taking breaks)
Narrator: "What if instead of striving for perfection, we focus on making progress?"

(Closing shot with the same person working at their desk, but with a more relaxed demeanor)
Narrator: "It's okay to not be perfect. It's okay to make mistakes."
caption: "The truth about perfectionism. Let's challenge our beliefs and focus on making progress instead of perfection. Share your thoughts in the comments below! #RationalThoughts #ProductivityHacks"
